source: # Solution Notebook: Extended Citi Bike Micro-Mobility Analysis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(geosphere)
})

set.seed(42)
n_obs <- 10000

all_data <- data.frame(
  tripduration = runif(n_obs, min = 180, max = 3600),
  start.station.latitude = runif(n_obs, min = 40.7000, max = 40.8000),
  start.station.longitude = runif(n_obs, min = -74.0200, max = -73.9300),
  end.station.latitude = runif(n_obs, min = 40.7000, max = 40.8000),
  end.station.longitude = runif(n_obs, min = -74.0200, max = -73.9300),
  birth.year = sample(1950:2005, n_obs, replace = TRUE),
  gender = sample(c(0, 1, 2), n_obs, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.4))
)

head(all_data)

ggplot(all_data, aes(x = start.station.longitude, y = start.station.latitude)) +
  geom_bin2d(binwidth = c(0.001, 0.001)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Simulated NYC Citi Bike Starting Density", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal()

short_trips <- all_data %>%
  filter(tripduration < 900) %>%
  mutate(age = 2020 - birth.year)

start_coords <- short_trips %>%
  select(start.station.longitude, start.station.latitude)

end_coords <- short_trips %>%
  select(end.station.longitude, end.station.latitude)

short_trips <- short_trips %>%
  mutate(
    distance = distHaversine(start_coords, end_coords),
    speed = distance / tripduration
  )

head(short_trips)

speed_demo <- short_trips %>%
  group_by(age, gender) %>%
  summarize(mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(gender = as.factor(gender)) %>%
  filter(age < 80, gender %in% c(1, 2))

ggplot(speed_demo, aes(x = age, y = mean_speed, color = gender)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Speed by Age and Gender",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Speed (m/s)",
    color = "Gender"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = c("Male Identifying", "Female Identifying")) +
  theme_minimal()

age_counts <- short_trips %>%
  group_by(age, gender) %>%
  tally() %>%
  filter(age < 80, gender %in% c(1, 2))

ggplot(age_counts, aes(x = age, y = n, fill = as.factor(gender))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Biker Volume by Age and Gender",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Trip Count",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("Male Identifying", "Female Identifying")) +
  theme_minimal()
